name: M7.Connectivity.closure_equiv_top
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (e : ZMod N ≃+ ZMod N) (S : Set (ZMod N)), AddSubgroup.closure (e '' S) = ⊤ ↔ AddSubgroup.closure S = ⊤
guidance: Use AddSubgroup.map_closure for e.toAddMonoidHom and inverse/surjectivity. This is used only for the literal unitEquiv, not a free final action isometry premise. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
